4 members of the Future Screw Crew, SATCHMO, China Alarm, Hedawn & Minimz, have teamed up to bring "Love Drvnk". The title can be read as "Love Drunk" or "Love Drank", a homage to Beyoncé's latest single and the purple lean we all enjoy. A sort of follow up to last years "Luv Is Screwed Up EP" by Trill Scott Heron (soundcloud.com/trill-scott_heron/sets/love-is-screwed-up), the collection of screwed tracks bring out the inner emotions on this momentous occasion. Pour a cup, relax, and listen to the tape whether your in a relationship or not this Valentines Day.

- Future Screw Crew

This is is the second instalment of the Future Screw Crew mixtape series. This time around we picked a theme: 'Club' music--which has its roots in late 80s English breakbeat--more specifically 'Baltimore Club' and 'Jersey Club'. Depending on what world you live in, Club probably sounds nothing like what its name has you thinking. Thanks to the power of the internet, Club music is quickly and violently gaining popularity and things could get pretty exciting soon. Thoroughly mesmerised by the refreshingly unique rhythm of Club, the Future Screw Crew has given the purple treatment to a selection of artists that we love, both established and struggling to be heard. Thank you to everyone who's work we screwed.

Keep Sippin' and Warm Regards,

- Future Screw Crew
